PLAN "2-Week Hotel Room Hypertrophy Maintenance"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "hypertrophy maintenance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Body Maintenance":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m

      DAY Tuesday training 35m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          high_knees 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          russian_twist 3x20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m

      DAY Thursday training 40m "Full Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          wrist_circles 1m

      DAY Saturday training 35m "Lower Body & Core Stability":
        warmup:
          marching 2m
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x16 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 1m
          butterfly_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
